Crawl stops before any fetch when robots.txt is unreachable

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::crawl;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":true}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = crawl(&engine, &url).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.pages.len());
    println!("{:?}", result.was_skipped);
    println!("{:?}", result.error);
}
```
